overall: The AG found the Richmond Board of Selectmen violated the Open Meeting Law by approving December 12, 2024 minutes late and posting a notice that did not list minutes dates; older allegations were declined as untimely.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly failed to approve minutes of the December 12, 2024 meeting in a timely manner.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law when it did not approve minutes of the December 12, 2024, meeting until February 12, 2025, more than 30 days and three meetings following the meeting.

allegations.summary: Allegation that the Board failed to timely approve minutes of the October 29 and December 4, 2024 meetings, filed too late.
allegations.key_passage: As the instant complaint was filed with the Board on March 6, 2025, more than 30 days after the alleged violations were reasonably discoverable, we decline to review the allegations as to those minutes.

allegations.summary: Notice of the February 12, 2025 meeting listed approval of minutes without identifying the minutes' dates.
allegations.key_passage: As the notice of the February 12 meeting did not list the date of minutes to be approved, we find that it was not sufficiently specific.

allegations.summary: Allegation that earlier meeting notices listing minutes approval failed to identify the minutes' dates, which was untimely.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review allegations that previous notices were also insufficiently specific for failure to identify the dates of minutes to be approved, as those alleged violations were reasonably discoverable at the time of the subject meetings, and thus the allegations are untimely.

allegations.summary: Not raised by complainant: the Board's executive session notices omitted 'Open Session', though the Board must first vote in open session.
allegations.key_passage: Such notices do not comply with the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Additional allegations raised for the first time in the complainant's request for further review.
allegations.key_passage: To the extent that the complainant raises additional allegations in the request for review, we decline to review them.

allegations.summary: Complaint suggested August 23, 2024 minutes appear unapproved because they are not posted online; Board did not respond.
allegations.key_passage: We do not make a finding as to that set of minutes, in light of our finding of a violation as to other minutes.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent and may result in civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation.
Approve all open session minutes not yet approved in a timely manner, including August 23, 2024 minutes if not yet approved, and certify to the AG within 60 days.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law and may result in the imposition of civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation.
